definitions.payment: an inbound USDT transfer >= 10 USDT from another wallet, before the freeze; one withdrawal by one customer (the sender)
definitions.first_warning_real: the first payment at which the engine raised a Tether freeze signal (counterparty: warning; destination: hold)
definitions.first_warning_modelled: the time of the first simulated customer report (made after a released or warned payment)
definitions.payments_after_warning: payments decided after the first warning existed (real: from that payment on, it is decided after the signal)
definitions.payments_source_warned: payments whose decision cites the source's signal (real: a warning shown; modelled: a hold)
definitions.payments_held: payments the engine put in the hold tier (call-back); each held attempt renews a report, an officer's cleared ends it
definitions.lead_days: freeze_ts - first warning ts, in days; median over wallets with a warning
definitions.payment_hold_rate: held payments / payments; on comparison wallets this is the legitimate-hold rate
definitions.false_report_rate: f: chance a legitimate customer reports the payee after paying (modelled)
definitions.officer: each hold starts a call-back; a day later the officer records confirmed or cleared; right with probability q (modelled)
